_comment: Same problem, same fix as recommendation-appsettings.json.
last configuration provider, which puts it above environment variables. Anything left in
this file would pin the consumer to localhost no matter what the Deployment sets.
So Kafka, Redis and ClickHouse are gone from here and come from env instead. What stays
is the batching behaviour, which has nothing to do with where anything lives.
ClickHouse:BatchSize and InsertDelayMs are the two knobs that decide how far behind the
sink runs: it inserts every 10s or every 100 events, whichever comes first.
